body.en: The *gynoecium* is made of one or more carpels, each with a stigma, style and ovary. If the carpels are free it is apocarpous, as in lotus and rose; if fused, syncarpous, as in mustard and tomato. After fertilisation the ovules become seeds and the ovary becomes the fruit.

body.en: *Placentation* is the arrangement of ovules in the ovary. Marginal: the placenta forms a ridge along the ventral suture of a one-chambered ovary, as in pea. Axile: ovules are attached to a central placenta in a multi-chambered ovary, as in China rose, tomato and lemon. Parietal: ovules develop on the inner wall of the ovary, which becomes two-chambered by a false septum, as in mustard and Argemone. Free central: ovules are borne on a central axis with no septa, as in Dianthus and Primrose. Basal: a single ovule is attached at the base of the ovary, as in sunflower and marigold.
body.kn: ಜರಾಯು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ: ಅಂಚಿನ (ಬಟಾಣಿ), ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ (ದಾಸವಾಳ, ಟೊಮೆಟೊ, ನಿಂಬೆ), ಭಿತ್ತಿಯ (ಸಾಸಿವೆ, ಆರ್ಜಿಮೋನ್), ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ (ಡಯಾಂಥಸ್, ಪ್ರಿಮ್‌ರೋಸ್), ತಳದ (ಸೂರ್ಯಕಾಂತಿ, ಚೆಂಡುಹೂ).

title.en: Fruit, seed and some important families
title.kn: ಹಣ್ಣು, ಬೀಜ ಮತ್ತು ಕೆಲವು ಮುಖ್ಯ ಕುಟುಂಬಗಳು

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. Stamens united in one bundle: monoadelphous; two: diadelphous; many: polyadelphous.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. ಒಂದು ಕಟ್ಟು ಏಕಸಂಘ, ಎರಡು ದ್ವಿಸಂಘ, ಹಲವು ಬಹುಸಂಘ.

say.en: Free carpels: apocarpous; fused carpels: syncarpous.
say.kn: ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ ಶಲಾಕೆ ವಿಯುಕ್ತ; ಕೂಡಿದ ಶಲಾಕೆ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ.

say.en: Placentation: marginal, axile, parietal, free central, basal.
say.kn: ಜರಾಯು ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ: ಅಂಚಿನ, ಅಕ್ಷೀಯ, ಭಿತ್ತಿಯ, ಸ್ವತಂತ್ರ ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಯ, ತಳದ.
